title: Admin - Track Admin Assignment Details - Functional Test Plan
overview: Functional testing of the Admin User & Role Management - Track Admin Assignment Details feature on the Y4J platform. This feature displays 'Assigned date' and 'Assigned by' information on each admin card for accountability tracking. The data is stored in audit logs and is immutable. Edge cases include missing assignment records and legacy admin accounts without assignment metadata.

testCases.title: Admin card displays assigned date
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. User & Roles page is loaded with at least one admin who was recently assigned.
steps: Navigate to User & Roles page
Observe an admin card
Locate the 'Assigned' date field on the card
expectedResults: The admin card displays an 'Assigned:' label followed by a date
The date is in a recognizable format (e.g., 'Assigned:2026-05-19')
The date is not empty or showing placeholder text
The date represents when the admin was assigned their role
testCases.postconditions: Assigned date is confirmed visible on the admin card

testCases.title: Admin card displays assigned by information
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. User & Roles page is loaded with at least one admin.
steps: Navigate to User & Roles page
Observe an admin card
Locate the 'Assigned By' field on the card
expectedResults: The admin card displays an 'Assigned By:' label followed by the assigner's identifier
The assigner is shown as an email or name (e.g., 'Assigned By:pv@mailto.plus')
The field is not empty
The assigner represents the Super Admin who created/assigned this admin
testCases.postconditions: Assigned by information is confirmed visible on the admin card

testCases.title: Newly created admin shows correct assigned date (today)
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. About to create a new admin.
steps: Note today's date
Create a new internal admin via the Add Internal Admin modal
After creation, find the new admin card in the list
Check the 'Assigned' date
expectedResults: The 'Assigned' date shows today's date (the date of creation)
The date format is consistent with other admin cards
The date is automatically set by the system (not entered by the user)
testCases.postconditions: New admin has today's date as assigned date

testCases.title: Newly created admin shows correct assigned by (current Super Admin)
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin (pv@mailto.plus). About to create a new admin.
steps: Create a new internal admin via the Add Internal Admin modal
After creation, find the new admin card in the list
Check the 'Assigned By' field
expectedResults: The 'Assigned By' field shows the current Super Admin's email (e.g., 'pv@mailto.plus')
The assigner is automatically set by the system based on the logged-in user
The assigner is NOT the newly created admin's email

testCases.title: Assignment data is immutable - cannot be edited by user
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admin cards with assignment data are displayed.
steps: Navigate to User & Roles page
Observe the 'Assigned' date and 'Assigned By' fields on any admin card
Attempt to click on or interact with these fields
Open the Edit Permissions editor and check if assignment fields are editable
expectedResults: The 'Assigned' date is read-only (not clickable, not editable)
The 'Assigned By' field is read-only (not clickable, not editable)
No edit controls (pencil icon, input field) exist for these fields
The Edit Permissions editor does NOT allow changing assignment metadata
These fields cannot be modified through any UI interaction
testCases.postconditions: Assignment data is confirmed immutable via UI

testCases.title: Assignment data persists after page refresh
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admin cards with assignment data are displayed.
steps: Navigate to User & Roles page
Note the 'Assigned' date and 'Assigned By' for a specific admin
Refresh the page (F5)
Find the same admin card
Compare the assignment data
expectedResults: After refresh, the 'Assigned' date is unchanged
After refresh, the 'Assigned By' is unchanged
Data is loaded from the backend (persisted in audit logs)
No data loss occurs on refresh
testCases.postconditions: Assignment data is consistent across page refreshes

testCases.title: Assignment data does not change when permissions are edited
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. An admin with known assignment data exists.
steps: Note the 'Assigned' date and 'Assigned By' for a specific admin
Click 'Edit Permissions' on that admin card
Add or remove a permission
Save the changes
Observe the 'Assigned' date and 'Assigned By' fields
expectedResults: After editing permissions, the 'Assigned' date remains unchanged
After editing permissions, the 'Assigned By' remains unchanged
Permission edits do NOT update the assignment metadata
Assignment data reflects the original creation/assignment, not the last edit
testCases.postconditions: Assignment data is unaffected by permission edits

testCases.title: Assignment data does not change when role is changed
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. An admin with known assignment data exists.
steps: Note the 'Assigned' date and 'Assigned By' for a specific admin
Change the admin's role (e.g., from Limited-Access to Super Admin)
Observe the 'Assigned' date and 'Assigned By' fields after role change
expectedResults: After role change, the 'Assigned' date remains unchanged
After role change, the 'Assigned By' remains unchanged
Role changes do NOT update the assignment metadata
The original assignment tracking is preserved
testCases.postconditions: Assignment data is unaffected by role changes

testCases.title: Missing assignment record - legacy admin shows fallback
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. A legacy admin account exists that was created before assignment tracking was implemented.
steps: Navigate to User & Roles page
Find a legacy admin card (one without assignment metadata)
Observe the 'Assigned' date and 'Assigned By' fields
expectedResults: The card does not crash or show errors for missing data
A fallback value is displayed (e.g., 'Assigned By:System' or 'N/A' or 'Unknown')
The date may show the account creation date or a placeholder
The card layout remains consistent with other admin cards
No broken UI or empty gaps appear
testCases.postconditions: Legacy admin cards handle missing data gracefully

testCases.title: System-created admins show 'System' as assigner
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. A system-created admin (initial setup admin) exists.
steps: Navigate to User & Roles page
Find an admin card that was created by the system (not by another admin)
Observe the 'Assigned By' field
expectedResults: The 'Assigned By' field shows 'System' (not a user email)
This indicates the admin was created during system setup or migration
The field is clearly distinguishable from user-assigned admins

testCases.title: Assignment date format is consistent across all admin cards
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Multiple admin cards are displayed.
steps: Navigate to User & Roles page
Observe the 'Assigned' date on multiple admin cards
Compare the date formats
expectedResults: All admin cards use the same date format (e.g., YYYY-MM-DD)
No inconsistencies in date formatting across cards
Dates are unambiguous (not DD/MM/YY which could be confused)
testCases.postconditions: Date format is consistent across all cards

testCases.title: Assignment details are visible on paginated pages
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admin list has multiple pages.
steps: Navigate to User & Roles page
Verify assignment details on page 1 admin cards
Navigate to page 2
Verify assignment details on page 2 admin cards
expectedResults: Assignment details (date and assigner) are displayed on all pages
Data on page 2 is correct for those specific admins (not duplicated from page 1)
Each admin card shows its own unique assignment data
testCases.postconditions: Assignment details work correctly across pagination

testCases.title: Assignment details are visible when search/filter is applied
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admin list is loaded.
steps: Navigate to User & Roles page
Apply a search query to filter admins
Observe the filtered admin cards
Verify assignment details are still visible
expectedResults: Assignment details remain visible on admin cards in search/filter results
Filtering does not hide or break the assignment data display
The data shown is correct for the filtered admins
testCases.postconditions: Assignment details display correctly with search/filter active
